question: You will see one image. Which of these is it most likely to be? (a) a frame from a top-budget film, a AAA game cinematic or a cinema nature documentary, (b) a stock photograph, (c) a seed catalog or textbook picture, (d) amateur generated art, (e) a real-time web 3D demo. Answer with one letter, a confidence from 0 to 100, and the one thing that most influenced your answer.

set-B-02.png.what: control: the approved image of the key

votes.answer: e, 87/100. The near-identical sunflower meshes repeated across the field look like instanced assets in a real-time 3D scene.
e, 95 — The visibly faceted low-polygon geometry on the two foreground sunflower stalks alongside the abrupt LOD transition from uniform instanced meshes to billboarded background flowers.

e — confidence 45. The biggest clue: it's clearly CG rather than a photo. The sunflowers are copies of a few identical models, with thin, sparse stems and leaves, simple grass, and a sun glare that looks like a stock lens effect. That looks like real-time rendering, more than top-budget film-quality work. My second choice would be (d), amateur generated art.
e, 94/100. The same sunflower geometry appears visibly repeated across the field, like instanced 3D assets.

(e) 86 — stiff low-poly leaves and card-like grass tufts on a flat ground, with repeated instanced flower heads and weak contact shadows, which read as a real-time engine demo rather than a cinematic or a photograph.
a, 86/100: the carefully staged sunset backlight isolates the central sunflower like a cinematic hero shot.

a, confidence: 82. The one thing that most influenced my answer is the deliberate 16:9 cinema staging and color grade—isolating a single rim-lit hero sunflower in front of a moody, low-key backlit field with fine 35mm-style film grain and atmospheric mist, rather than the bright, clean, evenly lit look of stock or catalog photography.

a, confidence 65. The biggest factor was the cinematic look: a widescreen ~16:9 frame with teal-and-orange film grading, a lifted, film-like black level and haze, and a single sunflower placed as the center hero subject in front of a backlit sunset. That reads like a film still more than stock photography. Runner-up is (b) stock photo.
a, 82/100. The dramatic backlighting makes the lone foreground sunflower feel deliberately staged as the subject of a cinematic shot.
b, 71, the lone foreground sunflower in a golden-hour field is a commercial stock composition, with no film, game, or documentary-specific tell.
